leftEvidence.title: Circumcision is named as a covenant sign

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: God commands Abraham and his offspring to circumcise every male as a sign in the flesh.
points.right: At a lodging place the LORD meets “him” and seeks his death; Zipporah circumcises her son and touches the foreskin to “his feet.”

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: An uncircumcised male is to be cut off from his people because he has broken the covenant.
points.right: Zipporah speaks of a bridegroom of blood, and the threat is released after her action and words.

payload.posture: Genesis defines circumcision as covenant practice; Exodus narrates Zipporah performing it under lethal pressure.

rightEvidence.title: Zipporah acts during a lethal encounter

payload.tension: The background clarifies the action’s covenant setting without proving the threatened person or the omitted offense.
payload.title: Covenant instruction and Zipporah’s act
